Lachen.desc: Lachen is the higher of Sikkim's two main villages in North Sikkim and the gateway to Gurudongmar Lake and the Chopta Valley. At ~2,750 m it is the last major settlement before the Tibetan plateau roads, and road trippers usually overnight here to acclimatize before the high-altitude lake. (sourced from Sikkim travel posts)

Yumthang Valley.desc: A scenic valley in North Sikkim at ~3,500 m, famous for its rhododendron blooms in spring and the hot springs at the far end. It is a standard day excursion from Lachung on the Gurudongmar road. (sourced from r/SoloTravel_India Sikkim threads)
